_doc: Shared conformance cases for policy pattern matching (SCHEMA.md §10). memo and memo_regex are NFKC-normalised, memo is stripped, matching is case-insensitive with ASCII-only character classes and no u flag. Both agents/tests and system_of_work tests load this file.

match_cases.why: Turkish dotted capital I is not ASCII i
trailing whitespace is stripped before matching
$ anchors the end of the whole memo only
Arabic-Indic digits are not \d under ASCII semantics
under ASCII semantics é is not a word character, so a word boundary exists before 'catering' on both sides
NFKC normalises the Kelvin sign U+212A to ASCII K before matching, so it matches on both sides
\x1c is not whitespace under ASCII semantics
an emoji is two code units in JS and one char in Python; both sides must agree: treat as no match by requiring BMP-safe semantics (memo length check uses code points, matching rejects astral chars)

match_cases.memo: Lunch at the wind  tunnel session
match_cases.why: double space does not match single space; no whitespace collapsing
fullwidth c in the REGEX is NFKC-normalised too
fullwidth c in the memo is NFKC-normalised to c

rejected_regexes.reason: inline flags are not allowed; case-insensitivity is always on
